notes.title: Patch V1.06.4 Released!
notes.content:
Patch V1.06.4 is now live, which contains:

- Hotfix for the failstate softlock some players were encountering.
- Minor UI Fixes and updates

Thanks for everyone who provided feedback!

notes.title: Patch V1.06.39 Released!
notes.content:
Patch V1.06.39 has been uploaded!

-Fixed 'arrow phasing through enemy' bug involving a substepping issue combined with a poorly sized hitbox for the default arrow type.
-Increased effectiveness of mind controlled skels.
-Re-balanced gold rewards.
-Fixed issue with a hidden achievement not triggering.

The first one that fixes 'arrows phasing through enemies' is an important fix and a direct response to player feedback. Thanks to everyone to brought it to my attention!
